items.summary: CTO disposition: approve containment-only execution. Continue existing repair-or-close, isolated deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, measurement, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Deferred opportunities remain technically feasible but are not queue-ready. Preserve private launch gates, parked dispositions, existing measurement boundaries, and unknown financial or causal outcomes.

Before any requeue or release, document ownership, root cause, smallest isolated repair, deterministic validation, rollback evidence, deduplication, and an available measurement boundary. Do not create duplicate work or request telemetry already present in the authoritative snapshot.
